title: Uniform symbol expansion of Gegenbauer polynomials
author: Kouichi Taira; Hiroyoshi Tamori
difficulty_reason: The polynomial degree must be extended to a smooth real parameter while preserving endpoint-uniform symbol derivatives. Branch selection, singular-endpoint amplitudes, and the degeneration of the phase derivative as the angle approaches 0 or pi require a parameter-scaled construction and rapidly decreasing remainder, rather than substituting a standard asymptotic formula.
